{"hypotheses": [
{"name": "Composite 1", "mechanism": "Firms with high R&D ability and low accruals are likely to outperform due to their innovative capabilities and efficient use of resources.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "RDAbility"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "Accruals"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Mom6m", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.8, "expected_decay_half_life_months": 24},
{"name": "Composite 2", "mechanism": "Companies with high intangible assets and low leverage are more likely to generate long-term value due to their ability to adapt to changing market conditions.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "IntanBM"}, {"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "Leverage"}], "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "vol_target": false}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.7, "expected_decay_half_life_months": 18},
{"name": "Composite 3", "mechanism": "Firms with high operating profitability and low idiosyncratic volatility are more likely to deliver stable returns due to their efficient operations and low risk profile.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "OperProf"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "IdioVolAHT"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "micro", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "STreversal", "bound": "above", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.9, "expected_decay_half_life_months": 30},
{"name": "Composite 4", "mechanism": "Companies with high customer momentum and low short interest are more likely to outperform due to their strong customer base and low short selling pressure.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "iomom_cust"}, {"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "ShortInterest"}], "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN", "vol_target": false}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_NEGATIVE", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "international", "region": "emerging", "direction": "opposite_sign"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.6, "expected_decay_half_life_months": 12},
{"name": "Composite 5", "mechanism": "Firms with high governance scores and low debt issuance are more likely to generate long-term value due to their effective management and low financial risk.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "Governance"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "DebtIssuance"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Mom12m", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.8, "expected_decay_half_life_months": 24},
{"name": "Composite 6", "mechanism": "Companies with high R&D expenses and low operating leverage are more likely to innovate and adapt to changing market conditions, leading to outperformance.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "RD"}, {"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "OPLeverage"}], "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "vol_target": false}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.7, "expected_decay_half_life_months": 18},
{"name": "Composite 7", "mechanism": "Firms with high intangible assets and low illiquidity are more likely to generate long-term value due to their ability to adapt to changing market conditions and low trading costs.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "IntanEP"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "Illiquidity"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "micro", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "STreversal", "bound": "above", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.9, "expected_decay_half_life_months": 30},
{"name": "Composite 8", "mechanism": "Companies with high operating cash flows and low net debt financing are more likely to deliver stable returns due to their efficient operations and low financial risk.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "CBOperProf"}, {"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "NetDebtFinance"}], "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN", "vol_target": false}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_NEGATIVE", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "international", "region": "emerging", "direction": "opposite_sign"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.6, "expected_decay_half_life_months": 12}
]}
